description.value: Indian Burger Joint is a 100% vegetarian and vegan fast-casual restaurant founded in 2023 by Navneet Bhadu, serving Indian-spiced burgers, naanwiches, grilled sandwiches, tacos, hotdogs, and chaat alongside Indian-style drinks like falooda and masala chai. The Downtown Vancouver location on Howe Street is part of a growing BC chain with five locations, distinguished by its use of authentic traditional Indian flavors and spices rather than meat substitutes. Dine-in, takeout, and delivery are all available, and the culturally immersive décor with Indian-themed murals and lively music makes it a memorable stop.
